summary: The physical definite-pair bound pi/sqrt(det B) with arbitrary outside coupling was already proved by account02/B06 and is not new in this run. The opposite-sign random-slope/Schur-remainder barrier also source-matches the existing account03/B06 correction. The surviving supporting lemma is the same-sign overlap compiler allowing an arbitrary measurable first-square center Phi(U,Z), arbitrary theta(Z),R(Z), with bound pi K_W K_U/sqrt(|ad|); random same-sign affine slopes are absorbed at zero cost. Full QFORM and full-target continuity remain open.
